// diagnostic

E1123

`{function}` uses `{denied}`, which target `{target}` denies.

What

`{function}` uses `{denied}`, which target `{target}` denies.

Why

An artifact built for `{target}` gets only the services that machine provides, and it lacks the one `{denied}` needs.

Fix

Keep the `{denied}` work out of the code this entry reaches, or build the entry for a target that provides `{denied}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1123: tests/ui/target_denied_effect_e1123.stderr.

Error [jet.TargetDeniedEffect]: `lister` uses `Exec`, which target `wasm32-unknown-unknown` denies
  --> tests/ui/target_denied_effect_e1123.jet:8:16
    |
  8 |     _: process.cmd(["ls"])
    |                ^^^
 Why: An artifact built for `wasm32-unknown-unknown` gets only the services that machine provides, and it lacks the one `Exec` needs
 Fix: Keep the `Exec` work out of the code this entry reaches, or build the entry for a target that provides `Exec`
